fusions.name: Sleeve Draw
fusions.desc: Throws a small hatchet that deals 5 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Unsheathed
fusions.desc: A sweeping cut that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Edge in the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick Second Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
